user.organization_type: a regional network of private hospitals and outpatient clinics

role.description: Independent data protection officer of a hospital network. Advises management and staff on personal data processing, monitors compliance and is the contact point for the data protection authority and for patients who exercise their rights.
responsibilities: GDPR and national data protection act compliance across all hospitals and clinics
advice on data protection impact assessments (DPIA)
data subject requests from patients and employees within legal deadlines
personal data breach assessment with IT Security and notifications within 72 hours
review of data processing agreements with vendors
privacy training for medical and administrative staff
data protection reports to the CEO and the Supervisory Board
ongoing_topics: rollout of a new electronic health record system

stakeholders.role_or_group: vendors of medical and IT systems
